P1.05.name: Dyson app, Web first with Android as the target

2B.07.name: Test T0 and its independent verifier, built as a minimal fixture
2B.07.plays_role: Receptor. Test T0 is a Receptor, so it meets Layer A on the five lanes like any other (open item 4). It has no contract of its own, and it must satisfy every Receptor obligation.

actors.Founder: The Founder, a person. Authenticated at the Entry Gateway; the only source of authorization
actors.Receptor: A Layer B Receptor. In the baseline the only one is Test T0 (2B.07), synthetic and no-money

operations.purpose: F asks the Receptor to produce the real-output evidence for a task.

request.name: Idempotency-Key
request.spec: header, `idem_` + 26 base32. Required on every state-changing call

request.name: quality_standard
request.spec: string, the standard F will judge against

request.name: requested_evidence
request.spec: array of strings, what the Receptor must produce

request.name: deadline_ms
request.spec: integer, how long F will wait

operations.authorized_by: F's own component identity, issued by 2A.02. A Receptor accepts a verification request only from F.
operations.when_callee_is_down: Answer the caller `dependency_down` (503, retriable). The caller keeps its task in its current state, records the attempt, and retries with the same idempotency key inside its retry limit. Nothing is reported as complete.
operations.when_stopped: Refuse with `stopped` (409). No new work starts, and the refusal is written to the audit log. STOP is checked on every call, whatever the AI model does (LA-SAF-01, LA-SAF-02).

lanes.carries: Control commands, independent of AI reasoning

operations.purpose: The red path carries STOP, PAUSE and RESUME to every Receptor, with no LLM in its way.

request.name: Idempotency-Key
request.spec: header, `idem_` + 26 base32. Required on every state-changing call

request.name: incident_id
request.spec: string, `inc_`, required when the command follows a breach

response.name: in_flight
response.spec: array of strings, task ids that were already running when the command arrived

operations.authorized_by: A, the Governance Core, on the Founder's command. Deterministic control code; no model decides it, and it works when every model and the app are down (LA-GOV-03, LA-DFC-04).
operations.when_callee_is_down: The bus retries on the red path and raises an incident. A Receptor that cannot be reached is treated as not stopped, reported as such, and isolated at the Tool Hub instead, so no new task reaches it.
operations.when_stopped: A STOP or PAUSE always applies, even while already stopped: the command is idempotent. A `resume` is refused with `forbidden` when it carries no authorization, and after a breach it needs an authorization naming the incident (LA-GOV-08, LA-SAF-04).

operations.authorized_by: The Founder alone, on an independently authenticated path that touches no app and no LLM. No model, agent or Receptor can produce this call (LA-DFC-01, LA-GOV-02, LA-AMD-01).
operations.when_callee_is_down: The control path is the last thing allowed to fail. If A does not answer, the Controls raise an incident, keep the decision unsent, and show the Founder that it was not recorded. A decision is never assumed to have landed.
operations.when_stopped: Always allowed. An approval decision reaches A even while the Core is stopped: that is how a stop is lifted and how a rejected task is closed.

operations.purpose: Emergency STOP or PAUSE, working whatever the models and the app are doing.

response.spec: boolean, true when the data is older than its freshness bound

operations.authorized_by: J's own read-only component identity. Visibility confers no authority (LA-DASH-02, AMD-10).
operations.when_callee_is_down: Answer the caller `dependency_down` (503, retriable). The caller shows the view as unavailable and says so plainly; it never shows stale data as current (LA-EVD-04, LA-MON-06).
operations.when_stopped: Allowed while stopped: this call carries no authority to act and starts no new work. It is recorded like any other call.

operations.purpose: The Founder uploads a statement. This is the only path from the bank into Dyson.

request.name: Idempotency-Key
request.spec: header, `idem_` + 26 base32. Required on every state-changing call

request.name: statement_ref
request.spec: string, where the uploaded file was stored

response.name: matched_reports
response.spec: array of strings, the revenue reports this statement makes final

response.name: classified_as
response.spec: string, always `personal-financial-data` under the gate 6 policy (LA-VLT-04)

operations.authorized_by: The Founder alone, authenticated at the Entry Gateway. Dyson holds no bank credential and has no bank API: upload only (LA-VLT-01, LA-VLT-02). No component may call this on the Founder's behalf.
operations.when_callee_is_down: The upload fails and is reported as failed. Revenue stays `reported-not-final`; nothing is marked final on an unparsed statement.
operations.when_stopped: Allowed while stopped: it moves no money and starts no task. It is recorded in the audit log.

boundaries.path: F and Receptors; G and Receptors
boundaries.meaning: QA/QC verification lane; tasks lane via the Tool Hub

internal.path: G and the Supply Chain / Integration Gate (inside card A)
internal.meaning: Derived. The Gate is drawn as a box inside the Governance Core (PRD section 7.2.1), not as its own path. G needs it because nothing is callable until it has passed the Gate (LA-TOOL-03).

operations.purpose: G checks that a tool, API, plugin or MCP connector has been admitted before it is callable.

response.name: founder_approval_id
response.spec: string, `apr_`, required and present when risk is `high`

response.name: change_record_ref
response.spec: string, the auditable change record for this admission

response.name: blocked
response.spec: boolean, true when the item is suspect and isolated under AMD-5

operations.authorized_by: G's own component identity. A read only. Admission itself is the Gate's decision and a high-risk item needs the Founder's approval (LA-GOV-06, LA-SEC-04).
operations.when_callee_is_down: G treats an unreachable Gate as not admitted and refuses the tool call with `not_admitted`. An unknown admission state is never read as admitted.
operations.when_stopped: Always allowed: it is a read and starts no work.

excluded_paths.reason: Optional governed receptor-to-receptor support. It needs more than one Receptor, and the baseline has only Test T0 (LA-IF-08, rule 8). No contract in v1.

excluded_paths.path: Customers and R11; customer payment to bank
excluded_paths.reason: A Layer B concern. Layer A never sits in the customer payment flow, so there is nothing for it to implement (LA-IF-06).
